summary: Robin Energy Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing the sale of the M/T Wonder Mimosa, a 2006-built Handysize tanker, for $12.8 million to an unaffiliated third party. The transaction closed on April 29, 2026, with an expected net gain of $6.7 million in Q2 2026. No board recommendation or advisors were named. The sale reduces the fleet to two LPG carriers. This is a non-US filer; the 6-K is equivalent to a US-issuer 8-K disclosure of a material asset sale. Watch for the recorded gain amount and potential use of proceeds.
